item.title: NVIDIA's Jetson Thor is Cool
item.description: Yesterday, NVIDIA released their latest state-of-the-art chip in their Jetson line of products, the Jetson Thor. Jetson Thor markets itself as, not just a chip, but an entire platform aimed at bringing artificial intelligence into the real world. I’ve been eyeing their Orion kit for a while now and, with this latest announcement, felt inspired enough to actually make a whole blog post about Jetson Thor.
